visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with two young women in a brightly lit indoor studio setting. The primary character on the left has blonde hair styled with a white Snoopy hair clip, wearing a striped grey and white hoodie. The second woman on the right has dark hair with a brown headband and a black top. They hold up large blind bags with bear illustrations. (2) The scene transitions to the women unboxing specific items. They hold a cardboard box with "KUMARU and FRIENDS" branding. They reveal a series of plush keychains shaped like ice cream cones featuring various animals like a squirrel, a panda, and a bear. (3) The women present a new box, "MELT THE DOSHI CAT," containing cat-themed candle figures. They show a Siamese cat figure and a multicolored cat figure, demonstrating their features. The background remains a soft-toned living room area with a couch. (4) The focus shifts to small product unboxings of "Finger Tips Doshi" keycaps. Close-up shots of their hands show tiny, detailed cat-shaped keyboard caps in pink and blue. (5) They move on to unboxing "Moo-u Girl" mushroom-themed plushies from a large colorful box. They reveal several variants, including red, black, and purple mushroom caps. (6) A montage sequence shows the aftermath of the unboxing session with empty boxes and wrappers scattered across a glass coffee table and a carpeted floor. (7) The final sequence shows the women showcasing all the collected items on a shelf and a refrigerator, concluding with them holding the original blind bags and waving to the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy electronic pop track featuring a steady beat. A female voice speaks with high enthusiasm and a fast tempo, greeting the audience. (2) A sharp plastic rustling sound occurs as the first blind bag is handled. The second female voice joins in, both speaking with a rising intonation and high arousal. (3) A "ding" sound effect emphasizes the reveal of the first plushie. The background music maintains a consistent, upbeat pace. (4) Frequent cardboard tearing sounds and plastic crinkles are audible as they move through multiple boxes. Occasional cartoonish "boing" or sparkle sound effects are used to highlight cute items. (5) A rapid sequence of "whoosh" sound effects accompanies the visual montage of the messy table. The voices exhibit peaks in volume during cheering segments. (6) The video concludes with a synthesized jingle and a final call to action delivered in a friendly, conversational tone over the fading music.
